list.name: store_id
list.label: Store
list.query: SELECT __value, __text FROM (SELECT '' AS __value, '(All stores)' AS __text, 0 AS sort_order UNION ALL SELECT id AS __value, name AS __text, 1 AS sort_order FROM stores) t ORDER BY sort_order, __text

panels.title: Declined Attempts / Card Testing
panels.description: Charge attempts grouped by customer document. Many attempts, mostly refused, small varied amounts in a short window is the card-testing signature. Reads payments directly, so it has data even for stores with fraudEnabled=false (WooCommerce auto-provisioned default).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p.customer->>'document' AS document,
  MIN(p.customer->>'name') AS name,
  MIN(p.customer->>'email') AS email,
  COUNT(*)::int AS attempts,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'refused')::int AS refused,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'refused') / COUNT(*), 0) AS refusal_rate,
  COUNT(DISTINCT p.amount)::int AS distinct_amounts,
  MIN(p.amount)::int AS min_amount,
  MAX(p.amount)::int AS max_amount,
  MIN(p.created_at) AS first_at,
  MAX(p.created_at) AS last_at,
  ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (MAX(p.created_at) - MIN(p.created_at)))/60) AS span_minutes,
  (ARRAY_AGG(p.id ORDER BY p.created_at DESC))[1:5] AS sample_payment_ids
FROM payments p
WHERE p.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND p.customer->>'document' IS NOT NULL
  AND ('$store_id' = '' OR p.store_id = '$store_id')
  AND ('$method' = 'all' OR p.method = '$method')
GROUP BY 1
HAVING COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.status = 'refused') >= $min_refused
ORDER BY refused DESC, attempts DESC
LIMIT 100;

panels.title: Risk Evaluations
panels.description: Fraud evaluations (Koin) joined with their payment. Only has data for stores with fraudEnabled=true — WooCommerce auto-provisioned stores default to fraudEnabled=false, so this stays empty for them (see the Declined Attempts panel above instead).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT fe.provider, fe.status, fe.score, fe.type, fe.created_at AS "createdAt",
  p.amount, p.currency, p.method, p.status AS payment_status, p.external_ref,
  p.customer->>'name' AS customer_name,
  p.customer->>'document' AS customer_document,
  p.customer->>'email' AS customer_email,
  p.customer->>'phone' AS customer_phone,
  fe.payment_id AS "paymentId"
FROM fraud_evaluations fe
JOIN payments p ON p.id = fe.payment_id
WHERE fe.created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND ('$store_id' = '' OR fe.store_id = '$store_id')
  AND ('$status' = 'All' OR fe.status = '$status')
  AND fe.score >= $min_score
ORDER BY fe.created_at DESC
LIMIT 200;
